identity.title: Show recipe health and navigate long-chain requirements

origin.summary: A seventeen-step feature/affine/measure/review recipe exceeded the Compact Flow viewport and did not expose the locations behind the global requirement state.

state.current_summary: PL-0011 is complete: Recipe Flow shows exact mutually exclusive health counts and bilingual non-wrapping requirement navigation, and current Release Wide/Compact evidence plus no-mutation regressions prove the seventeen-step workflow.

objective.summary: Provide at-a-glance recipe health counts and non-wrapping Previous/Next issue navigation that reveals the owning step and exact requirement.
constraints: Use existing stable step and artifact identities.
Navigation and expansion must not execute inspection or change recipe/source/result state.
Do not replace detailed Flow, Selected, Viewer, or evidence surfaces.
Support Wide and Compact with localized, accessible state text.

criteria.text: Recipe health distinguishes Ready, needs input, needs selection, needs parameters, stale Preview, and Published states with exact counts.
Previous/Next issue navigation reveals the owning step and requirement without wrapping, executing, or changing recipe data.
The seventeen-step study recipe remains reviewable in Wide and Compact without clipped required text or unreachable issue actions.

context.summary: The EXE-authored and reopened recipe contains seventeen steps; Compact Flow visibly showed the first ten and truncated several names and states.

evidence.observation: Tool Recipe teaching passed 46/46. The projection classified all 17 steps exactly once across Ready, Needs input, Needs selection, Needs parameters, Stale Preview, and Published; Previous/Next visited 14 unique requirements without wrapping and left recipe, source, state, dirty flag, and Preview/Publish/Run logs unchanged.

Current Release Wide and Compact English/Korean captures show the health counts, exact requirement detail, and reachable Previous/Next actions without clipped required text. The seventeenth step is scrolled into view with Next disabled, and a held native pointer-down capture keeps the Next button themed. The actual 1280x760 window rectangle intersected dynamically selected leftmost DISPLAY2.

events.summary: All three PL-0011 criteria are proved by focused state/navigation checks and current Release EXE Wide/Compact English/Korean evidence; PL-0013 is the next software priority and owner Wide/Compact R0 remains external.
